title: 第2章 老天开了个大玩笑
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
女仙人一甩袖飘然离去。

    顾衍视线扫向顾念念，抬手轻轻招了招：“过来。”

    顾念念立刻狗腿地跑上前，奈何高台太高，

    “爹？”

    顾衍的手轻轻地按在她的头顶，眸光中带着顾念念看不懂的复杂。

    顾念念仰着头，眉眼弯弯，笑得乖巧又讨喜。

    顾衍收回手，淡漠开口。

    “凡入青云宗皆有三道测验，这是宗规不可废。”

    顾念念很聪明，知道那女仙人不喜她，甚至有些厌恶。

    “既然是规矩，女儿是一定要遵守的！”

    小丫头眼底有着绝对的自信，大概以为这是个简单的事情。

    顾衍没有解释，更没有任何提醒。

    大殿外进来一人，眉眼清朗，神情冷淡。

    一身银灰色玄云袍衬得他超凡出尘，温润如玉。

    顾衍抬手点了点。

    “这是为父的大弟子洛靳，是你大师兄。”

    顾念念歪着头想了一会儿，有些笨拙的双手在胸前交叠作揖。

    “念念见过大师兄！”

    身为青云宗宗主的亲传大弟子，洛靳在宗门内声望地位都极高。

    见多了标准讨好的恭敬，陡见一个不伦不类歪歪扭扭的行礼，竟让他眉眼生出了几分笑意。

    “小师妹好。”

    说着，一柄通体粉红的小飞剑已经落在了顾念念的面前。

    “来的匆忙，身上没什么好物件，这个小师妹先拿着玩，正式的见面礼，师兄稍后补给你。”

    顾念念回头看了一下顾衍，见后者微微点头，这才欢快地收下了。

    “我很喜欢这个，多谢大师兄！”

    是真的喜欢，抱在怀里几乎是爱不释手了。

    她还没见过粉色的剑呢！

    顾衍看向洛靳，洛靳只是眉眼柔和的微笑。

    “你还有一个二师兄和大师姐，他们两个出门历练去了，等回来了再给你介绍。”

    顾衍说罢，挥了挥手。

    “洛靳，带念念去宗门测试吧。”

    “是！”

    沉重的大殿门在两人身后缓缓关闭。

    顾念念抱着粉红色的小剑，看着外面的世界，眼珠瞪得几乎要蹦出来。

    仙鹤啼鸣，白鹿嬉戏，云海飘渺中座座宫殿若隐若现。

    洛靳唤出飞剑，带着她踏剑而行。
content_en:
The female fairy flicked her sleeves and left.

    Gu Yan glanced at Gu Niannian, raised his hand and waved gently: "Come here."

    Gu Niannian immediately ran forward, but the platform was too high.

    "Dad?"

    Gu Yan's hand gently pressed on the top of her head, his eyes filled with complexity that Gu Niannian couldn't understand.

    Gu Niannian raised her head, arched her eyebrows and smiled cutely and endearingly.

    Gu Yan took back his hand and spoke indifferently.

    "Everyone who enters the Qingyun Sect must pass three tests. This is a sect rule that cannot be abolished."

    Gu Niannian was very smart and knew that the female immortal didn't like her, and even felt a little disgusted with her.

    "Since it is a rule, my daughter must abide by it!"

    The little girl had absolute confidence in her eyes, and she probably thought this was a simple matter.

    Gu Yan didn't explain, let alone any reminder.

    A person came in from outside the main hall, with clear features and a cold expression.

    The silver-grey Xuanyun robe makes him extraordinary and as gentle as jade.

    Gu Yan raised his hand and nodded.

    "This is my father's eldest disciple, Luo Jin, your senior brother."

    Gu Niannian tilted her head and thought for a while, folding her hands clumsily in front of her chest.

    "Nian Nian has met Senior Brother!"

    As the direct disciple of the leader of the Qingyun Sect, Luo Jin has a very high reputation and status within the sect.

    After seeing too much standard and flattering respect, he suddenly saw a nondescript and crooked salute, which actually made him smile a little.

    "Hello, little junior sister."

    As he spoke, a small pink flying sword landed in front of Gu Niannian.

    "I came in a hurry and don't have anything good with me. This little junior sister will take it to play with first. It's a formal meeting gift. Senior brother will supply it to you later."

    Gu Niannian looked back at Gu Yan and saw the latter nodded slightly, then accepted it happily.

    "I like this very much, thank you, senior brother!"

    I really like it, I almost can’t put it down when I hold it in my arms.

    She hasn't seen a pink sword yet!

    Gu Yan looked at Luo Jin, who just smiled softly.

    "You also have a second senior brother and senior sister. They have gone out for training. I will introduce them to you when they come back."

    After Gu Yan said this, he waved his hand.

    "Luo Jin, take Niannian to the sect for testing."

    "Yes!"

    The heavy hall door slowly closed behind the two of them.

    Gu Niannian held the pink sword and looked at the world outside, her eyes almost popping out of her head.

    Cranes crow, white deer play, and palaces are looming in the misty sea of ​​clouds.

    Luo Jin summoned the flying sword and led her on the sword.
title_en: Chapter 2 God made a big joke
